4279-6887-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6887-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4488-5627-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
4488-5627-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

1017-1494-3365-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Aeromoeba by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2744-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

1849-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
1849-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1849-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Mass Hysteria so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

1978-6893-7329.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-6893-7329.notes: You can instead tap The Eternity Elevator for colored mana if you're able to do so.

2099-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
2099-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2099-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

969-2366-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
969-2366-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

489-2908-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

955-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
955-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
955-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

3693-4613-6843-7186.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Collective Inferno.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4067-5181-5527-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
4067-5181-5527-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Golgari Findbroker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Golgari Findbroker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Golgari Findbroker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

628-3108-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
628-3108-5231.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

725-1336-4050-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 4 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
725-1336-4050-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {G/U}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

620-4574-6687-6688.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
620-4574-6687-6688.description:
Cast Arcbound Reclaimer by paying {4}.
When Arcbound Reclaimer enters the battlefield, Yotian Dissident and Sarinth Steelseeker trigger.
Resolve the Yotian Dissident trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting an artifact creature card from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarinth Steelseeker ability, putting the artifact creature card from the top of your library into your graveyard.
Unshakable Tail triggers, creating a Clue token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Yotian Dissident and Sarinth Steelseeker trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-3143-5696-6178.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6178.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Zektar Shrine Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Zektar Shrine Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

215-3821-4313.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{R}{G}.
215-3821-4313.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{R}{G}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it and Flameshadow Conjuring trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{R}{G}.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the token Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{R}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1992-2034-4981.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1992-2034-4981.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Basri's Lieutenant's second ability, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Knight.
Repeat.

240-643-4304-4528.description:
Cast Battle-Rage Blessing by paying {1}{B}, targeting a creature an opponent controls with power 1 or greater, giving that creature deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
Ayula triggers, causing that creature to fight the creature with deathtouch and indestructible.
Your creature dies, triggering Atla Palani, causing you to put the topmost creature card in your library onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3 until there are no creatures left in your library.

423-3510-4704.notablePrerequisites: Saproling Burst has at least two fade counters on it.
423-3510-4704.description:
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling and a Forest land due to Life and Limb.
Evolution Sage triggers, putting a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Repeat.

1605-3011-3946.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
1605-3011-3946.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each opponent equal to their life total, and causing it to deal no damage to you
